changing.line: The only thing that you keep changing
stanza: The only thing that you keep changing
Is your name, my love keeps growing
Still the same, just like a cancer
And you won't give me a straight answer

changing.line: You are changing me, you are changing
stanza: As the coastline is shaped by the wind
As we make love and you're on my skin
You are changing me, you are changing
I can't go through the motions
I can't go through the motions
How'm I supposed to do this now?
Say we went out strolling
Say we went out strolling
Say I went and told them how
I am afraid of changing
And when it comes a time to check and rearrange shit
There are things behind things behind things
And there are rings within rings within rings

stanza: Are you still in love with me
Like the way you used to be or is it changing?
Is it deeper over time

I've seen you changing
I've seen you changing

changing.line: I turned around, my life was changing
stanza: I turned around, my life was changing
What did I learn, it's not that easy
When you get burned and go on burning light

changing.line: Look at the light, and all the time it's a changing
stanza: Look at the light, and all the time it's a changing
Look at the light, climbing up the aerial
Bright, white coming alive, jumping off of the aerial
All the time it's a changing, like now
All the time it's a changing, like then again
All the time it's a changing
